item.title: Find a quiet recording slot
item.summary: Two students negotiate a room and equipment booking for a podcast.
item.transcript_text:
Dana: The sign-up sheet says Studio B is free at eleven. Shall we take it?
Ilyas: The room is free, but sound checks in the hall go on until noon. We need clean audio for the interview.
Dana: There's a one o'clock slot. Our guest can't come to campus then, though.
Ilyas: She said she can join online after twelve thirty. We can use Studio B at one and send her the meeting link.
Dana: Fine. Do we still need to collect the recorder?
Ilyas: Yes. The online call will capture her side. Our recorder gives us a clear backup of our questions. Let's collect it at twelve forty-five.

questions.prompt: Why is eleven a poor choice?
options: The guest is already on campus
questions.explanation: Sound checks in the hall continue until noon and could get into the recording.

questions.prompt: How will the guest take part?
options: She will leave a written reply
questions.explanation: The pair choose a one o'clock studio slot and send her a meeting link.

questions.prompt: Why do they still need the recorder?
options: To set up the meeting link
To record a backup of their own voices
To test the sound in the hall
To play old episodes to the guest
questions.explanation: Ilyas wants a clear local backup of the questions the students ask.
